carries the first render's inputs at first paint. html[data-theme] and colorScheme by the rule of resolveTheme and colorSchemeOf in src/lib/theme.ts (a saved light, dark or night wins; with none the system scheme picks light or dark, never night); then one attribute per reader-dependent input of the app's first render, named and ruled by src/lib/firstRender.ts firstRenderInputs (data-theme-pref, data-sponsor-area, data-install, data-discord-band, data-earn-band, data-earn-handle), so a first frame drawing every state shows this reader's by CSS. Each read on its own try/catch; nothing is fetched. tests/unit/web-theme.test.ts and tests/unit/web-first-render-boot.test.ts run this script against those rules. --> Page not found | make.fun

observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && for u in "https://make.fun" "https://www.make.fun" "https://makefun.io" "https://make.fun/bounties"; do printf "%-32s " "$u"; curl -s -o /tmp/mf.html -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n" -L --max-time 20 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "$u"; done; echo "=== isi ==="; python3 -c "
import re,html
s=open('/tmp/mf.html',errors='ignore').read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s)); t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t).strip()
print(t[:900])
"
